subject: ela
intro: Fifth graders use grammar correctly. Conjunctions join words or ideas (and, but, or; because, although). Prepositions show relationships (under, over, during). Perfect verb tenses use 'have': 'I have walked' (present perfect), 'I had walked' (past perfect). Keep verb tenses consistent, and use correlative conjunctions in pairs (either/or, neither/nor, both/and).

items.prompt: Which word is a conjunction in 'I stayed home because it rained'?

steps: 'Because' joins the two parts and shows a reason.

items.prompt: Complete the correlative pair: 'You can have ____ the cake or the pie.'

steps: Correlative conjunctions come in pairs; 'or' pairs with 'either.'
